convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'KaufWMAcross' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (open/close/position sizing), making automated conversion impossible without reimplementing the custom indicator and library logic.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - period duration in seconds for signal time calculation
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open time gating

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA operates

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: Up arrow signal triggers SELL_Close if SellPosClose is true; Down arrow signal triggers BUY_Close if BuyPosClose is true. Additionally, historical bar scan checks for prior opposite signals to set close flags when both open and close are enabled for same side.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input (0.1) serves as either lot size or percentage depending on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a two-buffer custom indicator (KaufWMAcross) where Buffer 1 = Up signals (buy arrows) and Buffer 0 = Down signals (sell arrows). Signal is detected when buffer value is non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE on the SignalBar (default bar 1 = previous completed bar). When both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are enabled, the EA scans historical bars forward from SignalBar+1 to find the most recent opposite signal to determine if a close should occur - this is a lookback confirmation mechanism. The Recount flag forces re-evaluation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. GlobalVariableDel_ cleans up persistent state on deinit. The TimeShiftSec value is added to SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE to create a signal timestamp used as a trade identifier to prevent duplicate entries.
python_conversion_notes: The KaufWMAcross custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it combines Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average (AMA with period 9, fast=2, slow=30) with a weighted MA (LWMA period 13) and generates crossover arrows. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library must also be reimplemented: it provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions with money management modes (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) and the CIsNewBar class. The historical bar scan for opposite signals (lines 131-157) is critical for exit logic and must be faithfully replicated. SL/TP of 1000/2000 pips are large values likely intended for 5-digit brokers (i.e., 100/200 pips actual); digit adjustment logic may be inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh and needs verification.
